018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.security.access;
019
020import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
021import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
022import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
023
024import java.security.PrivilegedExceptionAction;
025import java.util.ArrayList;
026import java.util.List;
027import org.apache.hadoop.conf.Configuration;
028import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HBaseTestingUtil;
029import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.HConstants;
030import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableName;
031import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Connection;
032import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.ConnectionFactory;
033import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Put;
034import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Result;
035import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.ResultScanner;
036import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Scan;
037import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Table;
038import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.security.User;
039import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.MediumTests;
040import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.SecurityTests;
041import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.util.Bytes;
042import org.junit.jupiter.api.AfterAll;
043import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
044import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeEach;
045import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
046import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
047import org.junit.jupiter.api.TestInfo;
048
049@Tag(SecurityTests.TAG)
050@Tag(MediumTests.TAG)
051public class TestAccessControlFilter extends SecureTestUtil {
052
053  private static HBaseTestingUtil TEST_UTIL;
054
055  private static User READER;
056  private static User LIMITED;
057  private static User DENIED;
058
059  private static TableName TABLE;
060  private static byte[] FAMILY = Bytes.toBytes("f1");
061  private static byte[] PRIVATE_COL = Bytes.toBytes("private");
062  private static byte[] PUBLIC_COL = Bytes.toBytes("public");
063
064  @BeforeEach
065  public void setup(TestInfo testInfo) {
066    TABLE = TableName.valueOf(testInfo.getTestMethod().get().getName());
067  }
068
069  @BeforeAll
070  public static void setupBeforeClass() throws Exception {
071    TEST_UTIL = new HBaseTestingUtil();
072    Configuration conf = TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration();
073    // Up the handlers; this test needs more than usual.
074    conf.setInt(HConstants.REGION_SERVER_HIGH_PRIORITY_HANDLER_COUNT, 10);
075    enableSecurity(conf);
076    verifyConfiguration(conf);
077
078    // We expect 0.98 scanning semantics
079    conf.setBoolean(AccessControlConstants.CF_ATTRIBUTE_EARLY_OUT, false);
080
081    TEST_UTIL.startMiniCluster();
082    TEST_UTIL.waitTableEnabled(PermissionStorage.ACL_TABLE_NAME.getName(), 50000);
083
084    READER = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "reader", new String[0]);
085    LIMITED = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "limited", new String[0]);
086    DENIED = User.createUserForTesting(conf, "denied", new String[0]);
087  }
088
089  @AfterAll
090  public static void tearDownAfterClass() throws Exception {
091    TEST_UTIL.shutdownMiniCluster();
092  }
093
094  @Test
095  public void testQualifierAccess() throws Exception {
096    final Table table = createTable(TEST_UTIL, TABLE, new byte[][] { FAMILY });
097    try {
098      doQualifierAccess(table);
099    } finally {
100      table.close();
101    }
102  }
103
104  private void doQualifierAccess(final Table table) throws Exception {
105    // set permissions
106    SecureTestUtil.grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, READER.getShortName(), TABLE, null, null,
107      Permission.Action.READ);
108    SecureTestUtil.grantOnTable(TEST_UTIL, LIMITED.getShortName(), TABLE, FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL,
109      Permission.Action.READ);
110
111    // put some test data
112    List<Put> puts = new ArrayList<>(100);
113    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
114      Put p = new Put(Bytes.toBytes(i));
115      p.addColumn(FAMILY, PRIVATE_COL, Bytes.toBytes("secret " + i));
116      p.addColumn(FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL, Bytes.toBytes("info " + i));
117      puts.add(p);
118    }
119    table.put(puts);
120
121    // test read
122    READER.runAs(new PrivilegedExceptionAction<Object>() {
123      @Override
124      public Object run() throws Exception {
125        Configuration conf = new Configuration(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration());
126        // force a new RS connection
127        conf.set("testkey", HBaseTestingUtil.getRandomUUID().toString());
128        try (Connection connection = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
129          Table t = connection.getTable(TABLE); ResultScanner rs = t.getScanner(new Scan())) {
130          int rowcnt = 0;
131          for (Result r : rs) {
132            rowcnt++;
133            int rownum = Bytes.toInt(r.getRow());
134            assertTrue(r.containsColumn(FAMILY, PRIVATE_COL));
135            assertEquals("secret " + rownum, Bytes.toString(r.getValue(FAMILY, PRIVATE_COL)));
136            assertTrue(r.containsColumn(FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL));
137            assertEquals("info " + rownum, Bytes.toString(r.getValue(FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL)));
138          }
139          assertEquals(100, rowcnt, "Expected 100 rows returned");
140          return null;
141        }
142      }
143    });
144
145    // test read with qualifier filter
146    LIMITED.runAs(new PrivilegedExceptionAction<Object>() {
147      @Override
148      public Object run() throws Exception {
149        Configuration conf = new Configuration(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration());
150        // force a new RS connection
151        conf.set("testkey", HBaseTestingUtil.getRandomUUID().toString());
152        try (Connection connection = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
153          Table t = connection.getTable(TABLE); ResultScanner rs = t.getScanner(new Scan())) {
154          int rowcnt = 0;
155          for (Result r : rs) {
156            rowcnt++;
157            int rownum = Bytes.toInt(r.getRow());
158            assertFalse(r.containsColumn(FAMILY, PRIVATE_COL));
159            assertTrue(r.containsColumn(FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL));
160            assertEquals("info " + rownum, Bytes.toString(r.getValue(FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL)));
161          }
162          assertEquals(100, rowcnt, "Expected 100 rows returned");
163          return null;
164        }
165      }
166    });
167
168    // test as user with no permission
169    DENIED.runAs(new PrivilegedExceptionAction<Object>() {
170      @Override
171      public Object run() throws Exception {
172        Configuration conf = new Configuration(TEST_UTIL.getConfiguration());
173        // force a new RS connection
174        conf.set("testkey", HBaseTestingUtil.getRandomUUID().toString());
175        try (Connection connection = ConnectionFactory.createConnection(conf);
176          Table t = connection.getTable(TABLE); ResultScanner rs = t.getScanner(new Scan())) {
177          int rowcnt = 0;
178          for (Result r : rs) {
179            rowcnt++;
180            int rownum = Bytes.toInt(r.getRow());
181            assertFalse(r.containsColumn(FAMILY, PRIVATE_COL));
182            assertTrue(r.containsColumn(FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL));
183            assertEquals("info " + rownum, Bytes.toString(r.getValue(FAMILY, PUBLIC_COL)));
184          }
185          assertEquals(0, rowcnt, "Expected 0 rows returned");
186          return null;
187        }
188      }
189    });
190  }
191}
